newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson has support for three proposals.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson has support for three proposals.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co Wednesday said it has received enough consents from shareholders of Great Western Financial Corp to adopt three proposals, including one that would require Great Western to hold its annual meeting by May 6.
In a statement, Ahmanson said it delivered consents representing more than the requisite majority of outstanding common shares of Great Western to adopt three of its five consent proposals.
Ahmanson is embroiled in a takeover battle with Washington Mutual Savings Bank for Great Western.

Ahmanson said it also delivered a majority of consents on a proposal which provides that Great Western cannot adjourn any meeting at which a quorum is present unless all business brought before it has been acted upon by shareholders and on a third proposal that provides that Great Western cannot amend any bylaw amendment adopted pursuant to Ahmanson consent solicitation without approval of the majority of shareholders.
According to Ahmanson, Delaware law provides that a consent proposal is adopted when valid, unrevoked consents representing a majority of outstanding common shares are delivered to the company.
